=== owners.POST.yml ===
composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Validate before Build so a missing or blank field is a 400 naming the offending
# fields, and the body is read (and republished) exactly once here.
validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureUniqueIdentity

# Reject a create that would be a second member of an existing household (same deterministic
# householdId, keyed on lastName + postcode), responding 409 — unless 'sharesHousehold' is set,
# which declares the caller intends to join the household and bypasses this block.
ensureUniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueOwnerIdentity

  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:

          title: Detail

          readOnly: true

      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:

          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. When structured address fields are supplied, this is the composed address (the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present); otherwise it is the normalized flat address. Accepted on input for backward compatibility.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat address when present. Normalized like address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. Normalized like address and, when present, appended to addressLine1 (single space) to form the composed address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional. When supplied it must be valid for the city's region via a fixed table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner. Optional. When supplied, drives the derived ageBand, which is computed as the owner's age on the registrationDate. ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner is already in the same household (the same last name and postcode). It only bypasses the duplicate block — the shared householdId is assigned automatically and deterministically regardless of this flag. A declared household member created this way is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Request-only override; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true

    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:

        - type: object
          properties:

              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. The raw telephone stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the region code derived from the owner's postcode and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest over the normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with the lastName. A stable identity carrying no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 5
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Derived from the owner's customerCode and registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier for the owner's household, computed deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the postcode. Owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically, regardless of creation order. Absent for owners with no postcode.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived duplicate-detection key, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (the email is empty when absent, the householdId is empty when the owner shares no household). Creation is rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole identityKey equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points. Starts at 0, gains 2 when an email is present, gains 1 when namesakeCount is 0, gains 2 for a household of three or more members, and gains 3 for a tenure of more than 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints - level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region for the owner, taken from the REGION component of the customerCode (the '<REGION>-<HASH8>' identity), i.e. the region derived from the owner's postcode, or 'UNKNOWN' when no region applies.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone for the owner's locality, from the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality has no mapped timezone (i.e. 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners share this owner's registration date (i.e. more than 80 owners were created for that business day), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner is not a hard duplicate but shares an existing (other) owner's lastName and postcode while carrying a different telephone, otherwise false. A soft-match warning; such an owner is still created.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches on lastName and postcode (with a different telephone), set only when possibleDuplicate is true; the earliest such owner when several match. Absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:

              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:

              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:

              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.

          required:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When supplied it drives the derived salutation. One of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. When structured address fields are supplied, this is the composed address (the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present); otherwise it is the normalized flat address. Accepted on input for backward compatibility.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat address when present. Normalized like address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. Normalized like address and, when present, appended to addressLine1 (single space) to form the composed address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional. When supplied it must be valid for the city's region via a fixed table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner. Optional. When supplied, drives the derived ageBand, which is computed as the owner's age on the registrationDate. ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner is already in the same household (the same last name and postcode). It only bypasses the duplicate block — the shared householdId is assigned automatically and deterministically regardless of this flag. A declared household member created this way is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Request-only override; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. The raw telephone stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the region code derived from the owner's postcode and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest over the normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with the lastName. A stable identity carrying no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 5
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Derived from the owner's customerCode and registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier for the owner's household, computed deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the postcode. Owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically, regardless of creation order. Absent for owners with no postcode.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived duplicate-detection key, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (the email is empty when absent, the householdId is empty when the owner shares no household). Creation is rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole identityKey equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points. Starts at 0, gains 2 when an email is present, gains 1 when namesakeCount is 0, gains 2 for a household of three or more members, and gains 3 for a tenure of more than 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints - level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region for the owner, taken from the REGION component of the customerCode (the '<REGION>-<HASH8>' identity), i.e. the region derived from the owner's postcode, or 'UNKNOWN' when no region applies.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone for the owner's locality, from the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality has no mapped timezone (i.e. 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners share this owner's registration date (i.e. more than 80 owners were created for that business day), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner is not a hard duplicate but shares an existing (other) owner's lastName and postcode while carrying a different telephone, otherwise false. A soft-match warning; such an owner is still created.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches on lastName and postcode (with a different telephone), set only when possibleDuplicate is true; the earliest such owner when several match. Absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band on the registrationDate, derived from birthDate when supplied - 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' when 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was given.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets

## Summary

The spec required accepting an optional `title` (MR/MRS/MS/DR) on the owner request and returning a derived `salutation` = `title + " " + lastName`, or just `lastName` when no title is given. Since the test writes via `POST /api/owners` and reads back via `GET /api/owners/{id}`, the title had to persist end-to-end.

Changes made:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added `title` (enum MR/MRS/MS/DR) to the `OwnerFields` schema so it binds from the request body, and added a read-only `salutation` string to the `Owner` response schema. These regenerate `OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto`.

2. **`Owner.java`** — added a persisted `title` column (`@Column(name = "title")`) with getter/setter, so the title survives to the `GET` read-back.

3. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — added the `salutation` mapping expression: `title` blank/null → `lastName`, otherwise `title + " " + lastName`. Title itself maps automatically by name (MapStruct handles the DTO-enum ↔ entity-String conversion, and `.name()` matches the enum values), so it flows request → entity → response.

4. **`db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`** — added the `title` column to the `owners` table in every dialect (tests run on hsqldb; the rest kept consistent).

Since the test writes via `POST /api/owners` and reads back via `GET /api/owners/{id}`, the title had to persist end-to-end.

Changes made:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added `title` (enum MR/MRS/MS/DR) to the `OwnerFields` schema so it binds from the request body, and added a read-only `salutation` string to the `Owner` response schema. These regenerate `OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto`.

2. **`Owner.java`** — added a persisted `title` column (`@Column(name = "title")`) with getter/setter, so the title survives to the `GET` read-back.

3. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — added the `salutation` mapping expression: `title` blank/null → `lastName`, otherwise `title + " " + lastName`. Title itself maps automatically by name (MapStruct handles the DTO-enum ↔ entity-String conversion, and `.name()` matches the enum values), so it flows request → entity → response.

4. **`db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`** — added the `title` column to the `owners` table in every dialect (tests run on hsqldb; the rest kept consistent).

Verification: `AcceptanceTest.coreComposesSalutation` (title `DR`, lastName `who` → `salutation` = `"DR who"`) passes, and the full `mvnw test` run reports `BUILD SUCCESS` with no failures or errors.
